title: Project Risk Register (Excel)
short: Empower your projects with this dynamic Excel-based **Risk Management Tool** — a smart, automated register that tracks, scores, and visualizes risks in real time for faster, data-driven decisions.

features.rest: Instantly calculates Inherent, Residual, and RPN (Risk Priority Number) using built-in formulas.
Automatically highlights top risks based on RPN or Residual score thresholds.
Summarizes open, high, medium, and low risks with auto-updating charts and color-coded visuals.
Displays real-time 5×5 probability-impact matrix with conditional color formatting.
Flags risks due for review within 0–7 days and overdue items automatically.
Differentiates between Open and Closed risks with dynamic color cues and filtering.
Simplifies data entry with predefined categories, risk owners, and probability/impact ratings.
Includes a customizable project info page with instructions for tool use and setup.
Fully functional with native Excel formulas and dynamic arrays — works on any system.
Generates summary tables for Top Risks, Upcoming Reviews, and Risk Trends with a single click.
Easily adjust RPN or Residual score thresholds to match your organization’s standards.
Structured sheets, modern formatting, and intuitive layout for corporate reporting.
